row.name: CorVel Corp. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)
checks.note: the session before the burst was up and not narrow

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=3 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.25 tightness=0.69 base_volume_vs_leg=1.41 base_volume_vs_avg=1.49
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 2.9% vs its 20-SMA, 2.4% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar's volume is only 30% of the prior session's (558k down to 170k), which is a hard VOL FAIL visible in the chart as a notably short bar on a day when the prior session's spike towers over it — this is the single most decisive flaw. RE also fails: the burst bar's 2% range is half the width of several bars in the preceding five sessions, meaning there is no genuine range expansion. The base is only three sessions and sits just below the recent multi-week high around 72.5–73, with the prior leg's linearity borderline (ER=0.24, well below 0.4, scraping by only on R2).
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts worked only 1 of 3 times in this move, and the name is pressing against a visible ceiling near 73 with shrinking volume — a failed breakout here has no nearby support until the 69 base low.
claude.entry_note: Skip if tomorrow opens below today's close of 71.83 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the session average, confirming continued lack of conviction.

row.summary: CRVL: +1.6% on 0.3× volume out of a base 5.3% deep. B 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
